Mean and SD

Can we check CLT using simulations

sim_mean_sd(n_obs = 30)
## # A tibble: 1 × 2
##    mean    sd
##   <dbl> <dbl>
## 1  12.0  4.03

Let’s do this but keep track of results

output = vector("list", length = 1000)

for (i in 1:1000) {
  
  output[[i]] = sim_mean_sd(n_obs = 30)
  
}

inspect results

output |> 
  bind_rows() |> 
  summarize(
    emp_m = mean(mean),
    emp_se = sd(mean)
  )
## # A tibble: 1 × 2
##   emp_m emp_se
##   <dbl>  <dbl>
## 1  12.0  0.551
output |> 
  bind_rows() |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = mean)) +
  geom_density()

Let’s do this using tibbles and map instead!

sim_results_df =
  tibble(
    samp_size = rep(30, 1000)
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    est_df = map(samp_size, sim_mean_sd)
  ) |> 
  unnest(est_df)

Look at results

sim_results_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = mean)) +
  geom_density()

change n

sim_results_df =
  expand_grid(
    samp_size = c(30, 60, 120, 240),
    iter = 1:1000
  ) |> 
   mutate(
    est_df = map(samp_size, sim_mean_sd)
  ) |> 
  unnest(est_df)
sim_results_df |> 
  mutate(
    samp_size = str_c("n = ", samp_size),
    samp_size = fct_inorder(samp_size)
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = samp_size, y = mean)) +
  geom_violin()

Look at the numbers

sim_results_df |> 
  mutate(
    samp_size = str_c("n = ", samp_size),
    samp_size = fct_inorder(samp_size)
  ) |> 
  group_by(samp_size) |> 
  summarize(
    emp_m = mean(mean),
    emp_se = sd(mean)
  )
## # A tibble: 4 × 3
##   samp_size emp_m emp_se
##   <fct>     <dbl>  <dbl>
## 1 n = 30     12.0  0.578
## 2 n = 60     12.0  0.374
## 3 n = 120    12.0  0.270
## 4 n = 240    12.0  0.199

SLR!!

generate once

sim_data = 
  tibble(
    x = rnorm(30, mean = 1, sd = 1),
    y = 2 + 3 * x + rnorm(30, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  )

sim_data |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'

fit = lm(y ~ x, data = sim_data)

fit
## 
## Call:
## lm(formula = y ~ x, data = sim_data)
## 
## Coefficients:
## (Intercept)            x  
##       2.358        2.874

turn this into a function

(i did that in source/sim_slr.R)

sim_slr(30)
## # A tibble: 1 × 2
##   beta0_hat beta1_hat
##       <dbl>     <dbl>
## 1      1.89      2.85

Do this a lot!

slr_results_df =
  tibble(
    samp_size = rep(30, 1000)
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    est_df = map(samp_size, sim_slr)
  ) |> 
  unnest(est_df)

is this right

slr_results_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = beta0_hat, y = beta1_hat)) +
  geom_point()
